projects.title: RushHour: A Dynamically Reconfigurable Lattice-Surgery Architecture
projects.title_original: RushHour: A Dynamically Reconfigurable Lattice-Surgery Architecture
projects.summary: RushHour reconfigures lattice-surgery layouts during execution to fit fault-tolerant programs onto smaller quantum chips.
projects.overview: RushHour coordinates logical qubit movement, routing space, and resource-state allocation. Its instruction set, lattice controller, and compiler support dynamic layouts.
method: The instruction set defines dynamic lattice operations and resource-state allocation.
The Lattice Management Unit manages layout changes and access to logical qubits.
The compiler maps logical circuits onto physical chips and overlaps instruction execution.
projects.result: On space-constrained chips, the evaluation reports median speedups from 2.3 to 7.2 times over the best feasible alternative.
